title: Great Eastern Women's Run 2026 Review: Singapore's Premier Women's Race at the National Stadium
seo_title: Great Eastern Women's Run 2026 Review | Singapore Race Guide
meta_description: The Great Eastern Women's Run 2026: November 1 at Singapore National Stadium. 21K to 100m kids dash — Southeast Asia's largest women's-only race reviewed.
dek: Set for 1 November 2026 at the Singapore National Stadium in Kallang, this Great Eastern-branded women's run offers five distances from a 100m kids dash to a 21.1K half marathon. Southeast Asia's premier women's-only road race with registration open.
verdict: The Great Eastern Women's Run is the largest women's-only road race in Southeast Asia — a Great Eastern-branded Singapore institution held at the National Stadium in Kallang. Five distances from a 100m kids dash to the 21.1K half marathon make it genuinely inclusive across ages and abilities. November in Singapore is the tail of the inter-monsoon period, offering relatively manageable humidity. Registration is open. For women runners who want a premier, women-focused race experience with big-event production values in Singapore, this is the standout pick in the region.

sections.heading: Southeast Asia's Premier Women's Race
paragraphs: The Great Eastern Women's Run has been Singapore's flagship women's-only race for years, drawing thousands of participants across five distances. [1] The National Stadium in Kallang — a world-class venue with excellent transport links — serves as the start/finish hub. Great Eastern's title sponsorship ensures professional production, quality race merchandise, and a polished finish-line experience.
